instruction.text: Select the sentence that uses a comma correctly.

b: ++There is an apple, a sandwich and a banana in his lunch box.
There is an apple a sandwich and a, banana in his lunch box.
There is an apple a sandwich, and a banana in his lunch box.
There is, an apple a sandwich and a banana in his lunch box.
We need to buy carrots cheese, and pasta at the shop.
We need to buy carrots cheese and, pasta at the shop.
++We need to buy carrots, cheese and pasta at the shop.
We need to buy carrots cheese and pasta, at the shop.
There is a book a camera, and a dictionary on the shelf.
++There is a book, a camera and a dictionary on the shelf.
There is a book a camera and, a dictionary on the shelf.
There, is a book a camera and a dictionary on the shelf.
We saw a squirrel a badger, and a fox in the woods.
We saw a squirrel a badger and a fox, in the woods.
++We saw a squirrel, a badger and a fox in the woods.
We saw a, squirrel a badger and a fox in the woods.
The family ordered pasta garlic bread, and pizza at the restaurant.
The family ordered pasta garlic bread and pizza, at the restaurant.
The family ordered pasta garlic bread and pizza at the, restaurant.
++The family ordered pasta, garlic bread and pizza at the restaurant.
++She plays rugby, tennis and football every week.
She plays rugby tennis, and football every week.
She plays rugby tennis and football, every week.
She plays, rugby tennis and football every week.
He enjoys reading cooking, and playing chess.
He enjoys reading cooking and, playing chess.
++He enjoys reading, cooking and playing chess.
He enjoys, reading cooking and playing chess.
They need to pack sun cream swimming costumes, and towels.
They need, to pack sun cream swimming costumes and towels.
They need to pack sun cream swimming costumes and, towels.
++They need to pack sun cream, swimming costumes and towels.
